    # Find the separator value
    # Find horizontal separator rows (all same value or full line)
    # Identify separator positions
    bg = grid[0][0]
    
    # Find rows that are entirely one value (separator rows)
    h_lines = []
    for r in range(rows):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[r][0] for c in range(cols)):
            h_lines.append(r)
    
    v_lines = []
    for c in range(cols):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(rows)):
            v_lines.append(c)
    
    # Find the largest cell
    # Build row segments and col segments between separator lines
    row_segments = []
    prev = -1
    for r in sorted(h_lines):
        if r - prev - 1 > 0:
            row_segments.append(r - prev - 1)
        prev = r
    if rows - 1 - prev > 0:
        row_segments.append(rows - 1 - prev)

        if c - prev - 1 > 0:
            col_segments.append(c - prev - 1)

        col_segments.append(cols - 1 - prev)
    
    max_h = max(row_segments)
    max_w = max(col_segments)
